text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages realized gains, but I should trim only when its outlook or my target allocation justifies it—not simply because it has risen.","Selling Stocks C and E at losses did not stop the account from later recovering; I should base sell decisions on long-term prospects and planned risk limits, not price moves or my average cost alone.","My account ended above its starting value despite monthly swings, so I should favor diversification and measured, infrequent decisions that support my retirement needs over trying to time short-term moves."]}
